audit.notes: OPPO 2025 新春限定 (restrict_spring_1002, publish 2025-01-12 / offline 2025-02-12). Bottom band 111 over a #B81817 plate, photo inset 10/10/10 (vendor size.leftMargin/topMargin/rightMargin) . Vendor element tree: column group width 340 -> seal 36x36 (CDN spring_2025_style1002_logo_v1, 288x289) centred with bottomMargin 8.33, model line (textSource 0) 10.5/700 tracking .04 lineHeight 12.6, greeting (textSource 5) 8/400 tracking .06 lineHeight 9.8. referenceWidth 360 = the JSON's own baseImageSize.
unsupported: vendor paints both lines with gradientType 0 over 5 stops (#D7AF5E/#FFE296/#F2BC54/#F4D189/#FFF5C4) across coordinateArray 20,30->166,30: the IR text node has one flat colour, so both lines use the middle gold #F2BC54
vendor fonts BulterBold.zip (model) and FZYaSongDB1GBK.zip (greeting) are not in the shipped font set: both lines fall back to font key 'sys' (StockSysSans)
vendor paint.withLogoTextSize 10.5 / noLogoTextSize 12: the seal is always drawn here, so the with-logo size is used
greetings[] holds 160 candidate lines and the client draws one at random per save; the IR carries the vendor's own aiContent default "春回大地 福运连" as a literal, the remaining 159 are not shipped
offlineTime 2025-02-12 has passed: the card is a data-accurate replica, not an on-sale official asset
机型行 text token=model 与源 JSON 一样只取照片 EXIF 的 Make/Model：照片没有 EXIF 时该行为空、引擎按空 token 不绘制（图案与祝福语照常出现），与既有 114 张厂商卡（哈苏 / 小米 / 宋干节 等）行为一致——不是本卡独有的缺项
